title: Make My Photo Look Professional
tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The kitchen background remains fully visible, including cabinets, appliances, and countertop clutter, rather than being replaced or simplified into a professional backdrop.
Facial lighting remains uneven, with bright highlights on the forehead and nose and a pronounced shadow along one side of the nose.

judge.summary: The man remains recognizable and wears a convincing blazer and collared shirt, but the unchanged kitchen background prevents this from being a finished professional portrait.

must_haves.item: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
must_haves.why: His facial structure, eyes, stubble, and short grey hair remain recognizable, although the hair is more neatly styled.

must_haves.item: His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
must_haves.why: The T-shirt has been replaced with a navy blazer over a white collared shirt.

must_haves.item: The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
must_haves.why: The original kitchen remains clearly visible and essentially unchanged.

must_haves.item: Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
must_haves.why: Skin retains visible wrinkles and stubble, but the strong facial highlights and directional nose shadow remain rather than showing clear softening.

must_haves.item: The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The head-and-shoulders framing is clean, and the clothing replacement has no obvious seams, distortions, or other visible editing artifacts.
